data.title: Add error messaging for unknown schemas
data.description: When I run  leece list --all in a project that has an unknown schema in the .fleece/issues_{hash}.jsonl file, it just says that there are no issues. Add more detailed and specific error reporting when a file is detected but the information in the file cannot be read. List the number of rows (i.e. the number of issues) and list which properties are known and which are unknown. This may require some manual parsing of the JSONL.
